prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury studio birthday portrait of a young Black boy seated confidently on a large matte white rectangular pedestal, centered in a vertical composition. He faces the camera directly with a bright natural smile, sitting upright with both hands resting comfortably on his knees and his legs hanging over the front edge. Dress him in a sharp black tuxedo with satin lapels, white dress shirt, black bow tie, black trousers, and glossy black loafers. Use a warm caramel-brown seamless studio backdrop and soft professional lighting with gentle shadows under the pedestal and shoes, polished editorial photography quality, crisp focus, realistic skin texture, and subtle highlights on the suit and balloons. Surround the setup with minimalist white display blocks: one large central block he sits on, one partial white block at the lower left, one tall narrow white block at the right, and one partial taller block at the far right. Add exactly 2 balloon arrangements: on the left, a clear oversized bubble balloon on a thin stand containing exactly 5 smaller balloons inside, 4 black and 1 white, tied with a white bow and long black-and-white tassel streamers; on the right, a floating cluster of exactly 7 visible helium balloons, 4 black and 3 pearl white, with thin black and white strings and a curled white ribbon. Keep the scene elegant, celebratory, and high-end, with no text, no cake, no candles, no watermark, and no extra props. Use a vertical 2:3 portrait crop, full body visible from head to shoes.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的奢华影棚生日人像，主角为 一名年轻的黑人男孩，他自信地坐在一个大型哑光白色长方形底座上，位于竖构图的中心。他直视镜头，露出灿烂自然的微笑，坐姿端正，双手舒适地放在膝盖上，双腿垂在底座边缘。为他穿上一套精致的 黑色燕尾服，搭配缎面翻领、白色衬衫、黑色领结、黑色长裤和黑色亮面乐福鞋。使用暖焦糖棕色的无缝影棚背景，采用柔和的专业灯光，在底座和鞋子下方投下柔和的阴影，呈现出精美的编辑摄影质感，对焦清晰，皮肤纹理真实，西装和气球上有细腻的高光。在场景周围布置极简主义的白色展示块：一个他所坐的大型中央底座，左下方一个部分可见的白色底座，右侧一个高窄的白色底座，以及最右侧一个部分可见的更高底座。添加 2 组气球布置：左侧是一个放置在细支架上的透明超大泡泡气球，内部包含 5 个小气球（4 个黑色，1 个白色），系着白色蝴蝶结和长长的黑白流苏；右侧是一簇漂浮的氦气球，共 7 个可见气球（4 个黑色，3 个珍珠白），系着细黑白绳和卷曲的白色丝带。保持场景优雅、喜庆且高端，画面中不含任何文字、蛋糕、蜡烛、水印或其他多余道具。使用 2:3 的竖向人像裁剪比例，全身可见，从头部到鞋子。
